Ot odam, joy yoki narsani nomlaydi; sifat xususiyatni, fe’l harakat yoki holatni bildiradi. Gapni ega → fe’l → davom tartibida yig‘ing.
student / happy / read so‘zlarini ajrating. ‘Happy’ odamning nomimi yoki holatimi?
O‘zbekcha tartibni so‘zma-so‘z ko‘chirmang. Inglizcha sodda gapda fe’lni tushirib qoldirmang.
I am; he/she/it is; you/we/they are. Davomida sifat, ot, sifat + ot yoki joy keladi. Inkor: be + not; savol: be + ega.
She is happy: kim? qanday? Is she happy: birinchi qaysi so‘z keldi?
He a teacher emas — He is a teacher. Are you happy? savoliga Yes, I am deb javob beriladi.
Sanaladigan birlik otga a/an yoki boshqa aniqlovchi kerak. A/an harfga emas, tovushga qaraydi. Ko‘plik va sanalmaydigan umumiy ot bilan artikl ko‘pincha ishlatilmaydi.
A university va an hour nega farq qiladi? Water ni one/two bilan bevosita sanaymizmi?
An university, informations, two childs o‘rniga a university, information, two children.
Ega: I/he/she; to‘ldiruvchi: me/him/her. My/yours kabi shakllarni ajrating: my + ot, mine mustaqil.
My book va mine dan qaysi biri otdan oldin keladi? He sees her gapida kim ko‘radi?
Mine book emas — my book. She knows he emas — She knows him.
There is + birlik, there are + ko‘plik. Have/has egalik; savol va inkorda do/does. Buyruqda fe’lning asosiy shakli; inkor buyruqda don’t.
There is a cat: mushuk borligini aytyapmizmi yoki kimligini? Don’t open — ruxsatmi, taqiqmi?
Does she has emas — Does she have. There have emas — There is/are.
Odat va faktlar: I work; she works. I don’t work; she doesn’t work. Do/Does + ega + asosiy fe’l. Takrorlanish ravishi asosiy fe’ldan oldin, be dan keyin.
Every day odatmi yoki aynan hozirgi ishmi? Does kelganda -s qayerda qoladi?
She don’t, Does she works o‘rniga She doesn’t, Does she work.
Hozirgi jarayon: am/is/are + V-ing. Savolda be oldinga chiqadi. Vaqtinchalik holat bilan odatni solishtiring.
I work va I am working: qaysi biri ayni paytdagi jarayon?
I am knowing emas — I know. She working emas — She is working.
Savol so‘zi + yordamchi + ega + fe’l. Ega haqida who savolida do/does shart emas. Vaqt: at six, on Monday, in May.
Who called? gapida noma’lum qism egami? Whose savoli kimni emas, nimani aniqlaydi?
In Monday emas — on Monday. Where you live emas — Where do you live?
O‘tgan be: was/were. Harakat: V2; inkor: didn’t + V1; savol: did + ega + V1. Aniq tugagan vaqtni ko‘rsating.
Yesterday voqeasi tugaganmi? Did bo‘lsa, went qoladimi?
Did you went emas — Did you go. I didn’t was emas — I wasn’t.
Fon jarayoni: was/were + V-ing. Qisqa voqea Past Simple bilan keladi. Used to eski odat yoki holatni aytadi; would odatda takrorlangan harakat uchun.
I was reading when he called: qaysi ish davom etayotgan edi?
Did you used to emas — Did you use to. O‘tgan doimiy holat uchun would ni avtomatik ishlatmang.
Will — qaror/taxmin; going to — niyat yoki ko‘rinib turgan dalil; Present Continuous — kelishilgan reja. Future time clause da when dan keyin odatda Present Simple.
Look at the clouds: taxmin dalili bormi? Tomorrow at ten uchun uchrashuv kelishilganmi?
When I will arrive emas — when I arrive. I going to emas — I am going to.
Have/has + V3: o‘tmishning hozirga aloqasi. For — davomiylik, since — boshlanish. Aniq tugagan yesterday bilan Past Simple ni solishtiring.
Has gone: u qaytganmi? Has been: tashrif tugaganmi?
I have went emas — I have gone. I have seen it yesterday o‘rniga I saw it yesterday.
Have been + V-ing jarayonga urg‘u beradi. Had + V3 boshqa o‘tgan voqeadan oldingi ish. Had been + V-ing o‘sha paytgacha davom etgan jarayon.
Three pages — natijami? For two hours — davomiylikmi? Qaysi voqea oldin sodir bo‘lgan?
Perfect shakllarda have/had va V3 ni tushirib qoldirmang; barcha fe’llarni continuous ga aylantirmang.
Qiyoslash: -er / more, orttirma: the -est / the most. Many/few sanaladigan; much/little sanalmaydigan. A few/a little — oz bo‘lsa ham bor.
Few va a few ning ohangi bir xilmi? More taller da ikki qiyoslash bormi?
More better emas — better. Enough ot oldida, sifatdan keyin: enough time, old enough.
Can/could + asosiy fe’l. Be able to boshqa zamonlarda imkon beradi. May I / Could I ruxsat, Could you iltimos.
Could you open the door? qobiliyat testi yoki odobli iltimosmi?
Can to swim emas — can swim. She cans emas — she can.
Must/have to — majburiyat; mustn’t — taqiq; don’t have to — zarur emas. Should — maslahat. Needn’t have + V3 bajarilgan, lekin keraksiz ishni bildiradi.
You don’t have to come: kelish taqiqlanganmi?
Mustn’t va don’t have to ni almashtirmang. Should to emas — should + fe’l.
Must be kuchli taxmin, might be ehtimol, can’t be imkonsiz taxmin. O‘tgan taxminda modal + have + V3.
Must have left: buyruqmi yoki o‘tgan voqea haqida taxminmi?
Must had emas — must have. Should have done ni hozirgi maslahat bilan aralashtirmang.
Zero: if + present, present. First: if + present, will. Second: if + past, would. Shartni hozirgi/kelajakdagi real imkon yoki tasavvur sifatida ko‘rsating.
If I had wings: real reja yoki tasavvurmi?
Odatdagi First conditional da if I will emas — if I do. If oldinda bo‘lsa, ikki qism orasiga vergul.
Third: if + had V3, would have V3. Mixed da ikki qism turli vaqtga tegishli. Wish + past — hozirgi noreal holat; wish + had V3 — o‘tgan afsus.
If I had slept, I wouldn’t be tired now: shart qachon, natija qachon?
I wish I have emas — I wish I had. Wish va hope ni ma’nosiga qarab ajrating.
Passive: kerakli zamondagi be + V3. Harakatdan ta’sirlangan narsa ega bo‘ladi. Zamon be qismida ifodalanadi.
The room is cleaned: kim bajargani muhimmi yoki xona?
Is clean va is cleaned ma’nosi farq qiladi. Was build emas — was built.
Will be V3, modal be V3, was being V3, had been V3. Bajaruvchi zarur bo‘lsa by bilan beriladi.
Was being repaired jarayonmi? Had been repaired oldin tugagan natijami?
Will been emas — will be. Passive fe’lning oxirgi qismi V3 bo‘lishi kerak.
Say + gap; tell + shaxs + gap. O‘tgan reporting verb bilan zamon ko‘pincha ortga siljiydi. Reported question da oddiy ega-fe’l tartibi.
She asked where I lived: bu bevosita savolmi?
She said me emas — she told me. Where did I live tartibini reported savolda saqlamang.
Who — shaxs, which/that — narsa, whose — egalik. Defining zarur aniqlovchi; non-defining qo‘shimcha ma’lumot va vergullar bilan.
My brother, who lives abroad: qo‘shimcha ma’lumotni olsak, asosiy gap qoladimi?
Non-defining da that ishlatmang. Ega bo‘lgan relative pronoun ni tushirmang.
Fe’lning keyingi shaklini birikma sifatida o‘rgating: enjoy doing, decide to do, make somebody do. Predlogdan keyin -ing.
Stop smoking va stop to smoke: qaysisida chekish to‘xtaydi?
Enjoy to read emas — enjoy reading. Used to do va be used to doing boshqa tuzilmalar.
Because + gap, because of + ot. Although + gap, despite + ot/-ing. Bog‘lovchini munosabatga qarab tanlang: sabab, natija, qarshilik yoki maqsad.
Despite the rain da ega-fe’l bormi? So that dan keyin to‘liq gap kerakmi?
Despite of emas — despite. Although va but ni bitta bog‘lash uchun takrorlamang.
Murakkab egada asosiy ot fe’lni boshqaradi. -ed his, -ing ta’sir. Indirect question da ega-fe’l tartibi. Tag savol yordamchi fe’lga mos.
The list of names: asosiy ot list mi, names mi?
Everyone are emas — everyone is. Do you know where is he emas — where he is.
Future Continuous: will be V-ing — kelajakdagi jarayon. Future Perfect: will have V3 — muddatgacha tugagan ish. By muddati bilan at vaqtini solishtiring.
At six va by six bir xil ma’nomi? Qaysi gapda ish tugagan?
Will have finish emas — will have finished. By the time dan keyin odatda Present Simple.
